canonical_questions: How do I reset my password?
knowledge_snippet: To reset your password, use the 'Forgot password' link on the sign-in page and follow the emailed reset link, which expires after 30 minutes.
system_instruction: Answer only about resetting a password, use email for personalization.
answer_template: We've sent password reset instructions to {email}. The link expires after 30 minutes.
escalation_fallback: If you don't receive the reset email, please contact a human agent.
